create.name: Dr. Mario Martinez
create.bio:
Mario Martinez is a clinical neuropsychologist and the founder of the Biocognitive Science Institute, whose work asks how cultural beliefs shape the way people age, fall ill and stay well. He has spent decades studying healthy centenarians in many countries and argues that those who thrive past a hundred relate to time, meaning and identity in a particular way, which he calls centenarian consciousness. He also writes and teaches about the mind-body relationship through what he names biocognitive theory, and he has lectured widely in English and Spanish.

Alongside that research he draws on contemplative traditions: his webinars set practices such as St Teresa of Ávila's Prayer of Quiet beside modern neuropsychology, exploring what becomes knowable when the effort to find answers is set aside, and his talks range over compassion, the Buddhist four immeasurables, synchronicity and the fear of death. He offers an on-demand video course on lessons from healthy centenarians, a paid membership with live discussions, and small-group immersions at coastal venues, the next in Galicia in spring 2027. His YouTube channel holds hundreds of his talks and interviews.

courses.title: Beyond the Known: What Becomes Possible When We Stop Looking for Answers
courses.description: A 90-minute live webinar pairing St Teresa of Ávila's Prayer of Quiet with neuropsychology, exploring contemplative quiet as a way of knowing; open to people of any faith or none.

courses.title: Spain Spring 2027 Immersion
courses.description: A small residential gathering at the Parador de Baiona in Galicia, where his work on culture, time and longevity is explored through shared experience over four days.

courses.title: Lessons from Healthy Centenarians
courses.description: A seven-module on-demand video course on the four factors he identified in years of studying people who live well beyond a hundred.

courses.title: The Young Methuselahs Outlier Membership
courses.description: A yearly membership built on his idea of centenarian consciousness, with members-only live webinars and book discussions, recorded reflections and a self-assessment.
